reason: Complete visual redo after v2 rejection
brief: Reduce decoration to meaningful foreground instruments rather than repeated labels or boxes
Use SVG for all decorative geometry and animate the foreground with requestAnimationFrame
Keep the status rail continuous and flat, with rules and spacing instead of stacked cards
Keep mobile collapsed by default and expanded as a covering overlay

options.label: 轨道档案
options.thesis: 一枚黄铜轨道装置围绕当前角色运转，指针把最新状态钉回场次。
options.animation: 前景轨道与指针持续转动，状态信号以脉冲节奏回应。

options.label: 龙脉剖面
options.thesis: 一组像地形测绘的龙脉线穿过档案，关系与位置沿路径相连。
options.animation: 前景等高线以不等速描边流动，节点缓慢偏移而不制造噪声。

options.label: 封印仪轨
options.thesis: 单一龙族封印成为状态栏的前景焦点，四条关系射线保持信息秩序。
options.animation: 封印环轻微摆动，核心与信号线以节拍脉冲，强调当前角色而非背景。
